header.title: Remote Info Display
header.subtitle: Easy way to manage info display content centrally

login.guide1: Log in to get editing rights.
login.guide2: Only authorized users can upload files.
login.guide3: Enter your email address in the field below.
login.guide4: Click "Generate OTP" – you will receive a 6-digit one-time code to your email (check spam folder too).
login.guide5: Copy the code from your email and paste it into the "One-time code" field.
login.guide6: Click "Verify" – the admin panel will open automatically.
login.guide7: If you get an error, check that:
login.guide7a: your email is on the whitelist (ask admin if unsure)
login.guide7b: the code is entered correctly (6 digits)
login.guide7c: the code has not expired (valid for 5 minutes)
login.helpText: Having trouble logging in? Contact the system administrator.

dashboard.guide1: Upload files by clicking "Select file" and choosing a file from your computer. The preview shows how the file will look on the display before uploading.
dashboard.guide2: Allowed file types: JPG, PNG, MP4 and PDF (max size 50 MB).
dashboard.guide3: You can set an expiry date after which the file is automatically removed from the display. Files without a date will not expire automatically.
dashboard.guide4: Click "Upload file" – the progress bar will show upload progress. The file appears in the list immediately after uploading.
dashboard.guide5: Files appear on the info display automatically within a few minutes (on the Raspberry Pi device).
dashboard.guide6: Display time — change the number on the file row (in seconds) and press Enter. Default is 10 seconds. Videos always play to the end.
dashboard.guide7: Order — drag the ⋮⋮ icon on the file row to change the display order on the info display.
dashboard.guide8: Hide / Show — the ⏸ button hides the file from the display without deleting it. The ▶ button brings it back. Hidden files appear dimmed in the list.
dashboard.guide9: Download file to your computer — click the filename in the list.
dashboard.guide10: Permanently delete a file by clicking the "Delete" button and confirming.
dashboard.guide11: Offline mode: If the info display shows red, the device is not connected to the internet or is not powered on. The display may still work with locally cached content.
dashboard.guide12: For issues, contact the system administrator.
